title: acer rubrum var. stenocarpum
intro: Acer rubrum var. stenocarpum, commonly known as Red Maple Dwarf, is a variety of the Red Maple tree, a deciduous tree native to eastern North America. It is valued for its ornamental and medicinal properties, with health benefits that include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Acer rubrum var. stenocarpum include its ability to promote wound healing, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a useful treatment for various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are also being studied for their potential to inhibit the growth of cancer cells.
